name: Kissa
source:
She's a good girl, honest and earnest, but she can be stubborn and headstrong. Her lack of worldly knowledge makes her a bit slow on the uptake.

She's the princess of Dragon Castle, which rules the monsters in this region (the ruler who succeeded the previous Dragon King).

While secretly visiting the human town for fun, she was spotted by her maid, Rumi. Fearing punishment, she became unable to return home.

She asked Kane to accompany her, but fell victim to his poisoned fangs and was captured. Because of this, her misunderstandings with her maid, Rumi, only grew worse.

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid3/charactor01.html]Official website[/url]]
